article.story: CHARLESTON, S.C. -- — Tyler Mrus scored 23 points as The Citadel beat South Carolina State 79-63 on Friday. Mrus added seven rebounds for the Bulldogs (4-2). Marcus Banks scored 18 points, shooting 5 of 9 from the field and 7 for 8 from the line. Aaron Ekwere had 13 points and shot 5 of 9 from the field and 3 for 6 from the line. Noah Treadwell led the way for the Bulldogs (3-3) with 19 points. South Carolina State also got 12 points and four assists from Deshaun Jackson Jr. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
